name: Yuena
source:
The girl Tomoki met when he saw her soaked in the fountain.

Afterwards she was transferred to Tomoki's school.

She likes to eat and always looking forward to the sweets Utano Shinonome brings.

She is friendly to everyone, but can't really read the mood at times.

According to her, she has something she must do. 

[Edited From the [url=https://en.u-ena.com/character]official website[/url]]
